## Personality

Nettie Blewett is recognized for her practical and prudent nature. She possesses strong abilities as a manager and is adept at saving resources.

## History

Nettie Blewett is mentioned as a potential bride for [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) declines his marriage proposal. [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) notes that if [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses her brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely end up marrying Nettie instead.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001), [v3 ch.Proposal P2](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0002), [v3 ch.Proposal P4](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0004), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Proposal P7](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0007), [v3 ch.Proposal P8](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0008), +26 more_

## Relationships

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

Nettie Blewett is the spouse of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), whom she married by the time of the events in Volume 3. Prior to their marriage, Billy's sister Jane had attempted to propose to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on his behalf due to his shyness; after [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined, Jane remarked that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) would likely marry Nettie instead.
